script:
echo '=== crontab ==='
sudo crontab -l 2>&1 | head -20
echo '=== timers ==='
systemctl list-timers --all 2>/dev/null | head -12
echo '=== site dir ==='
ls -la /var/www/xinmo-site | head -12
echo '=== git? ==='
ls -d /var/www/xinmo-site/.git 2>/dev/null || echo no-git
echo '=== deploy scripts on vps ==='
ls -lt /root 2>/dev/null | head -10
